datasets.name: CGMacros
datasets.notes: All 45 participants (15 healthy, 16 prediabetes, 14 T2D by HbA1c); 5-min Dexcom G6, Fitbit HR/METs, photo-logged meal macros; no medication records.

datasets.name: ShanghaiT2DM
datasets.notes: Non-insulin records only (45 of 109; 64 with any insulin excluded); 15-min FreeStyle Libre H, text meal records (carbs estimated by GlycoTwin's food rules), oral agents mapped to Pratibimb's catalogue; no wearables.

limitations: Real-data twin uses population priors from the EHR (no per-patient tuning); the EnKF and all twin settings were fixed on synthetic validation patients and not re-tuned on these records.
Twin forecast is plasma glucose and is scored against CGM (interstitial) readings.
ShanghaiT2DM meals are carbohydrate estimates from free text (some imputed); CGMacros macros are photo-based estimates. Meal glycaemic index is unknown (fixed at 55).
No waist (WHtR from BMI), no sleep or HRV in either dataset; ShanghaiT2DM has no wearables; CGMacros has no medication records; diabetes duration is defaulted for CGMacros.
Insulin-treated ShanghaiT2DM records (64 of 109) are excluded: Pratibimb models basal glargine only.
Only 87 people (90 records, ~10-14 days each); Chinese and US cohorts, not Indian patients.
Transfer model was trained on synthetic plasma-glucose labels (>250 mg/dL runs) with 5-min CGM features; real ShanghaiT2DM CGM is 15-min, so CGM-gap features are out of distribution.
Research prototype; not clinically validated; not a medical device.
notes: REAL DATA: CGMacros (PhysioNet, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and ShanghaiT2DM (figshare, CC BY 4.0) via GlycoTwin's harmonised store; derived records stay in git-ignored data/real; only aggregates are published here.
Forecast points: GlycoTwin's 15-min timestamps after each record's first 24 h where twin, GlycoTwin LightGBM, persistence, linear and all three targets exist (identical points for every method).

glycotwin_lgbm = GlycoTwin's own out-of-fold LightGBM predictions (oof_predictions.parquet) read at the same timestamps; it was trained on all 154 records (incl. insulin users) with patient-level 5-fold CV.
Twin 80% interval: ensemble p10-p90 widened by the scale fitted on synthetic validation patients ([3.103, 2.991, 2.783]), applied unchanged.
Linear = last CGM + 30-min slope x horizon (Pratibimb's baseline); persistence = current CGM.
Risk: GlycoTwin features and person-level folds (models/folds.json), LightGBM with GlycoTwin's fixed settings (250 rounds, no early stopping); identical windows (after 24 h) for every model.
ge180_2h = current <180 and any CGM >=180 in next 120 min; gt250_2h = current <250 and any CGM >250 in next 120 min (>=6 of 8 future 15-min readings present).
transfer_no_retrain = synthetic-trained Pratibimb hybrid hyper_2h (>250) model applied as is; for ge180_2h the same score is used, so it ranks a different event than it was trained on.
synthetic_vs_real ratios are synthetic / real (same label rules on 15-min CGM).
